headline: Kelpsea Aqua Spout
title: Kelpsea | Attack Boost For Water Pals | Palworld Guide
video_script: Building a Water team? Kelpsea helps. Its partner skill, Aqua Spout, raises the Attack of Water Pals in your party, and it does not stack. At base it works Watering at level one, and it sometimes drops Aquatic Pal Fluids at the Ranch. It is a Water Pal from the early Paldeck, so it is easy to add. Which Water Pal is your favorite? Comment below!
description: Kelpsea in Palworld 1.0: Aqua Spout boosts Water Pal attack, plus Watering level one and a Ranch drop.
